headline: Peru ProInversión Auctions Petroperú Real Estate Assets Valued at $9.6 Million
summary: Peru's private investment agency ProInversión launched a public auction for nine land plots owned by state oil firm Petroperú in Piura, valued at a combined $9.6 million.
why: State asset divestment programs provide non-tax fiscal revenue and help restructure balance sheets of state-owned enterprises like Petroperú.
